unit_of_aggregation: (sequence, camera) view; frames are NEVER pooled across sequences
primary_metric: relative focal error in percent, 100 * |f_hat - f_ref| / f_ref, where f_ref is GT_EFFECTIVE_FOCAL = the dataset-provided native fx
secondary_metrics: per-view bias and within-view spread, decomposed as in CAM-EXP-004
share of views flagged FLAT_PROFILE or BOUNDARY_SOLUTION
uncertainty: cluster bootstrap over the 40 physical cameras, 10000 iterations, 95 % percentile interval

comparators.what: predict, for every view, the median GT reference focal of the whole rig
comparators.why: the GigaHands rig has a single-focal confound (SINGLE_FOCAL_RIG_CONFOUND, reference focal CV 1.90 % across 175 views). Any method that does not beat this constant has demonstrated no per-view focal information at all.
comparators.not_a_method: it uses the evaluation targets and could not be formed without them

pre_registered_thresholds.H1_reference_hand_carries_focal_informat: the main condition must beat CONSTANT_RIG_FOCAL_ORACLE on median relative focal error, with a cluster-bootstrap 95 % interval on the paired difference that excludes zero
pre_registered_thresholds.H2_the_information_is_geometric: every control must be worse than the main condition by at least a factor of 2 in median relative focal error
pre_registered_thresholds.H3_more_frames_help: N = 16 must beat N = 1 by at least 2 percentage points of median relative focal error

decision_tags.E: WEAKLY_IDENTIFIABLE (a large share of FLAT_PROFILE or BOUNDARY_SOLUTION flags)
decision_tags.G: BLOCKED (the solve could not be run as specified)

honesty_rules: a result opposite to the hypothesis is reported unchanged
no frame, view, threshold or grid point is chosen by looking at the focal error
the ceiling reported here is an UPPER BOUND under an oracle reference hand and must never be described as achievable performance
